name: agentic-quality-engineering-demo
description: A portfolio-ready Agentic Quality Engineering experiment using specialized QA agents, reusable skills, and Playwright.

scripts.test:portfolio: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('allure-results/portfolio',{recursive:true,force:true})" && cross-env ALLURE_RESULTS_DIR=allure-results/portfolio playwright test --project=portfolio-showcase && allure generate allure-results/portfolio --clean -o reports/allure-portfolio
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
